name: MARN 3811
title: Seminar on Marine Mammals
description: Instructors from different areas of expertise discuss the natural history, evolution, anatomy, physiology, husbandry, and conservation of marine mammals. Current research is emphasized. (Special registration: Contact Mystic Aquarium, Mystic, CT 06355. 860-572-5955.)
requirement_description: One year college laboratory biology. Offered at the Mystic Aquarium.
